*** x -  x  JAN  FEB  MAR  APR  MAY  JUN  JUL  AUG  SEP  OCT  NOV  DEC

*** target (NUPTGT in Table-type NIT-YIELD) times the monthly fraction (in
*** Table-type MON-NUPT-FR1) times the layer fraction for the month.
